subject: How can I update input$(click id)$domain when domains of ggplot2 objects change?

messages.author: 6f3dc36d9a2717cb
messages.subject: How can I update input$(click id)$domain when domains of ggplot2 objects change?
parts:
Hi, I have a problem.

When I write plotOutput("myplot", click="click_id") in ui.R, I can get clicked coordinates by input$click_id$x and input$click_id$y in server.R. 
However, the domain of these (input$click_id$domain) is not updated even after I change xlim or ylim of my ggplot object.
Therefore, if I changed a dataset in the same plot, its input$click_id$x and input$click_id$y become meaningless. 

Are there any solutions?
I tried to change the domain by input$click_id$domain$left <- ggplot_build(my_ggplot_object)$panel$ranges[[1]]$x.range[1], 
but it returned "Attempted to assign value to a read-only reactivevalues object" error.
